description: Custom music disc plugin for Paper servers. Upload any audio file, get a playable disc.

releases.notes:
# v2.2.1

## Bug Fixes & Enhancements
- **Fixed Java Jukebox Interactions:** Resolved a critical bug where custom discs would instantly eject when inserted by a Java player, resulting in ghost music playing indefinitely and holograms failing to display.
- **Fixed Disc Deletion on Jukebox Break:** Breaking a jukebox or blowing it up with a Creeper/TNT will now properly drop the custom disc item natively instead of voiding it.
- **Fixed PacketEvents NPE on Purpur/Forks:** The plugin now dynamically injects explicit Minecraft version definitions for non-standard Paper forks (such as Purpur), preventing a NullPointerException thrown by PacketEvents during initialization.
- **Hologram Transparency Fix:** Fixed a severe visual bug where translucent blocks like Water, Ice, and Stained Glass would become entirely invisible (culled) when viewed through a Jukebox hologram.
- **Optimized Geyser Boot Cycle:** Refactored the geyser reload cycle. The plugin will no longer forcefully reload Geyser's packs during initial server startup, preventing severe boot stutters. Pack updates are now restricted exclusively to runtime generation.

# v2.2 Changelog

## Important Fixes for Bedrock & Geyser
- **(Fixes #2: Vanilla Music disks dont have any sounds to them after plugin install)** Changed the internal base item of custom discs from `music_disc_XX` to `paper`. This permanently bypasses a known Geyser client-side prediction bug, entirely fixing the double-audio overlap and vanilla disk muting issues when Bedrock players insert discs. 
- **(Fixes #1: Bedrock resource packs needs version bump in manifest.json on adding new tracks)** Implemented automatic version array bumping for the Bedrock `manifest.json` whenever tracks are added/removed. This properly forces Bedrock clients to download the newest pack!
- Fixed a bug where Bedrock (Geyser) players would trigger uncontrollable music if they right-clicked an active Jukebox while holding a vanilla disc.
- Significantly increased the Bedrock sound playback range! Bedrock volume multipliers are now hardcoded to be exactly 4x of the Java range, meaning Bedrock players can walk much further away before the music fades out, keeping it perfectly consistent with Java clients.
- Added `auto-reload-geyser` to `config.yml`. When enabled, the plugin automatically reloads Geyser's mappings internally when a disc is added or deleted. Bedrock players only need to disconnect and reconnect to fetch the updated packs; full server restarts are no longer required for most disc updates.

## Vanilla Mechanics Parity & Dupe Fixes
- Modified Jukebox ejection logic. Right-clicking an active Jukebox with any item (including another disc) will now strictly stop the music and eject the current disc to match vanilla Minecraft behavior 1:1.
- Fixed a severe item duplication bug that could occur when forcefully swapping a custom disc into a Jukebox that contained a vanilla disc.
- Reduced the default Java Jukebox attenuation range from 64 blocks down to 48 blocks for a more balanced fade-out distance.
- Ensured custom discs drop naturally from the Jukebox inventory when the block is physically broken.

## Optimizations & Cleanups
- Added SHA-1 hash caching for Java resource pack generation. The plugin now skips rebuilding the resource pack on server startup unless a disc was actually modified, preventing unnecessary pack download prompts for players.
- Integrated bStats metrics tracking.
- Added a support for PurpurMC

# v2.1 Changelog

### Added
- Added the /disc add <id> <url> <name> <author> [style] command to download and convert audio files asynchronously from a URL in the background.
- Added the /disc delete <id> and /disc remove <id> commands to completely remove custom discs and their audio files.
- Added tab completion support for the new add and delete commands.
- Added a search filter button in the /disc catalog menu that closes the GUI and lets players type a query in chat to filter discs.
- Added a local audio preview feature: middle-click or right-click any disc in the catalog to hear a 15-second preview locally.
- Added auto-allocation of unique CustomModelData IDs for custom discs starting at 10001.
- Added automatic texture overrides: if a custom PNG is placed at plugins/peyajCustomDisc/discs/<discId>.png, the plugin will automatically generate item model JSON files inside the resource pack.
- Added style-matching particles (flames, sculk, enchant table glyphs, and water splashes) that spawn above active jukeboxes depending on the music style playing.
- Added bStats metrics tracking to monitor server usage stats.

### Changed & Fixed
- Updated config.yml with options to configure custom sound volume, pitch, category, display range, and local preview durations.
- Enhanced item stack lore displays to include Artist, Duration, Style, and description notes dynamically.
FIRST RELEASE OF THIS PLUGIN, ALL THE FEATURES ARE IN README AND BUGS ARE EXPECTED.
